title: Glotto config
description: Configuration for the Glotto AI translator. CLI flags override values defined here.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocomplete.

key.description: API key for the AI provider.

model.description: Model name for the selected provider.

output.description: Single target file path or array of paths (one per target language).

to.description: Target language name or array of names. Length must match output array.

url.description: Custom base URL for OpenAI/Anthropic providers.

maxBatchSize.description: Maximum source size per batch in KB.

stats.description: Print AI usage statistics at the end of the run.

incremental.description: Translate only missing or empty keys when target file already exists.
